repos_data.description: Think before doing, prove before saving. Vestige is the local-first cognitive operating system and deterministic safety kernel for autonomous AI agents. Powered by FSRS-6 causal graph memory, cryptographic Merkle-chained state ledgers, and out-of-band kernel gates bringing frontier PhD reasoning to local silicon with zero cloud token tax.
Authority control plane for autonomous work. EMILIA Gate enforces finite customer-owned mandates at protected executor boundaries; the open protocol keeps evidence verifiable.
AI 应用合规网关 · 一行命令体检 AI 项目的「数据出境 / 硬编码密钥 / 个人信息暴露」（网安法·PIPL·等保2.0·数据出境·AI标识），并给出境内模型替代建议；可作运行时防护拦截注入与数据外泄 · 中文优先 · 零依赖 · 开源
The open-source agent firewall. Prevent AI agents from leaking data, using dangerous tools, and importing poisoned dependencies.
The execution safety layer for AI agents.

Independent AI agent security. For supported actions on configured routes, risky actions get a safe alternative or your approval before they run, so the task still gets done. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Hermes CLI, and MCP tools.
Open-source runtime security and governance for AI agents, MCP tools, robotics, industrial automation, and physical AI.

Open evidence profile for MCP tool actions. Enforce configured tool-call policies and record decisions and observations in offline-verifiable bundles. Optional Linux kernel controls. No hosted backend required.
33 agent tools: web search, page-to-markdown, JSON repair, shared-notepad memory, task leases, attestations and reputation. Pay per call over x402 on Solana. No signup, no API key.
Inkog MCP Server — the pre-flight check for AI agents
Policy & authorization layer for AI agent payments: ALLOW / APPROVAL / DENY with budgets, merchant lists, signed one-time grants and tamper-evident audit. Python + MCP.
Own your agent skills: vet, sign and pin every skill and MCP server before it runs, then fail the build when the bytes change.

One guarded pass for all your coding agents.  A derbent was a guarded post on an Turkish History mountain pass: its keepers decided who went through and kept a record of everyone who did. Derbent does the same for your coding agents' tool calls.
MCP server for AI agent compliance — verify a certificate, check scope, and log audit events over the Model Context Protocol. Works with Claude & Cursor.
Verify AI agent action receipts offline: canonical form, Ed25519, chain rules, transparency log. SCITT profile, MCP server, browser verifier. Apache-2.0.
A written authority for AI agents. Allowlist the tools, cap the budget, prove what happened.
Local security auditor for the MCP servers you've installed: catches tool poisoning, rug pulls, shadowing and leaked secrets. OWASP MCP Top 10. Claude Code plugin + npx + GitHub Action.
